description.zh: 新开的文件夹窗口并到已经开着的资源管理器里，成为一个标签页。需要 Windows 11 22H2 或更新
description.en: A folder that opens in a new File Explorer window becomes a tab of the window already open. Needs Windows 11 22H2 or newer

notes.zh: 有的电脑上新开的文件夹窗口一直不并成标签页，日志里每个已开着的窗口都被系统报成“隐藏”（invisible），连看得见的也是。这一版只多记日志：对每个这样的窗口写明它的实际状态、读取时有没有出错、属于哪个程序，以及资源管理器自己认为它是显示还是隐藏，好分清是真被藏起来了还是读不到（#331）。合并的规则没有变。需要主程序 0.32.0。权限不变。
notes.en: On some PCs new folder windows never become tabs: the log has every open window reported "invisible", visible ones included. This version only logs more: for each such window its actual state, whether reading it failed, its program, and whether Explorer itself says it is shown, to tell a window really hidden from one that cannot be read (#331). The merging rules are unchanged. Requires WinShun 0.32.0. Permissions unchanged.
